Warehouse Associate - Day Shift
Calloway Supply Co. | Reno, NV

Calloway Supply Co. is a regional distributor of plumbing and HVAC parts. Join Calloway and start a career with a team that has served Nevada contractors since 1987.

Responsibilities
- Pick, pack and ship customer orders using RF scanners
- Receive inbound shipments and check them against purchase orders
- Load and unload trucks safely; keep aisles clean and organized
- Operate a forklift after company-paid certification

Requirements
- No experience necessary: we train you
- Able to lift 50 lbs and stand for a full shift
- Valid driver's license required

Pay: $21 per hour, with a $1.50 shift differential for weekend work. Immediate start for qualified candidates.

Apply in person at 400 Kietzke Lane or at callowaysupply.com/jobs. Background check and E-Verify are required after an offer of employment.
